name: Oracle - Monitor Performance by DB Script
description: See details of Oracle listener process activity, including database connections by host and application, connection failures, command execution status and trends and other data derived from the Oracle Listener log.
title: Oracle - Monitor Performance by DB Script

panels.title: Last 10 Recent Jobs in the Database

queries.queryString:
db.cluster.name={{db.cluster.name}} deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} sumo.datasource=oracle "job status" | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as oracle_log_message
| parse field=oracle_log_message " queryoutput=*" as jsonOUT 
| json field=jsonout "TOTAL_TIME", "WHAT", "NEXT_DATE", "LOG_USER", "NLS_ENV", "INTERVAL", "LAST_DATE", "SCHEMA_USER", "MISC_ENV", "BROKEN", "JOB", "PRIV_USER", "MONITOR_TYPE", "FAILURES" as TOTALTIME, WHAT, NEXT_DATE, LOG_USER, NLS_ENV, INTERVAL, LAST_DATE, SCHEMA_USER, MISC_ENV, BROKEN, JOB, PRIV_USER, MONITORTYPE, FAILURES
| parse field=jsonout "\"MISC_ENV\": \"*\"" as MISC_ENV nodrop
| where monitorType="job status"
| timeslice 1s
| count by _timeslice, TOTALTIME, WHAT, NEXT_DATE, LOG_USER, NLS_ENV, INTERVAL, LAST_DATE, SCHEMA_USER, MISC_ENV, BROKEN, JOB, PRIV_USER, MONITORTYPE, FAILURES 
| fields -_count
| sort by _timeslice
| limit 10

db.cluster.name={{db.cluster.name}} deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} sumo.datasource=oracle "session waits" | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as oracle_log_message
| parse field=oracle_log_message " queryoutput=*" as jsonOUT 
| json field=jsonOUT "MONITOR_TYPE","SECONDS_IN_WAIT","USERNAME","STATE","EVENT" as monitorType, secondsinwait, username, state, event
| where monitorType="session waits"
| timeslice by 5m 
| max(secondsinwait) group username, _timeslice 
| transpose row _timeslice column username

db.cluster.name={{db.cluster.name}} deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} sumo.datasource=oracle "datafile status" | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as oracle_log_message 
| parse field=oracle_log_message " queryoutput=*" as jsonOUT 
| json field=jsonOUT "MONITOR_TYPE","FILE_NAME","FREE_SPACE_MB","ALLOCATED_MB","USED_MB" as monitorType, filename, freespace, allocated, usedSpace
| where monitorType="datafile status"
| (usedSpace/allocated*100) as Percent_datafilespace_Utilization
| timeslice 5m
| max(Percent_datafilespace_Utilization) as Percent_datafilespace_Utilization by filename, _timeslice
| sort by Percent_datafilespace_Utilization desc 
| transpose row _timeslice column filename

db.cluster.name={{db.cluster.name}} deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} sumo.datasource=oracle "datafile status" | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as oracle_log_message
| parse field=oracle_log_message " queryoutput=*" as jsonOUT 
| json field=jsonOUT "MONITOR_TYPE","FILE_NAME","FREE_SPACE_MB","ALLOCATED_MB","USED_MB" as monitorType, filename, freespace, allocated, usedSpace
| where monitorType="datafile status"
| (usedSpace/allocated*100) as Percent_Datafilespace_Utilization
| format( "%.2f",Percent_Datafilespace_Utilization) as Percent_Datafilespace_Utilization
| avg (Percent_Datafilespace_Utilization) as avg_percent_Datafilespace_Utilization

db.cluster.name={{db.cluster.name}} deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} sumo.datasource=oracle "active sessions" | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as oracle_log_message
| parse field=oracle_log_message " queryoutput=*" as jsonOUT 
| json field=jsonOUT "MONITOR_TYPE","USERNAME","STATUS","MACHINE","PROGRAM","SERIAL#" as monitorType, USERNAME, STATUS, MACHINE, PROGRAM, serial 
| where monitorType="active sessions" and STATUS = "ACTIVE" 
| count_distinct(serial) as numConnects by username, machine
| sort by numConnects

db.cluster.name={{db.cluster.name}} deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} sumo.datasource=oracle "tablespace status" | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as oracle_log_message
| parse  field=oracle_log_message " queryoutput=*" as jsonOUT 
| json field=jsonOUT "Tablespace Name", "USED_SPACE", "MONITOR_TYPE","TOTAL_SPACE","FREE_SPACE" as tablespace_name, usedSpace, monitorType, totalSpace, freeSpace
| where monitorType="tablespace status"
| (usedSpace/totalSpace*100) as Percent_Tablespace_Utilization
| format( "%.2f",Percent_Tablespace_Utilization) as Percent_Tablespace_Utilization
| avg (Percent_Tablespace_Utilization) as avg_percent_Tablespace_Utilization

db.cluster.name={{db.cluster.name}} deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} sumo.datasource=oracle "buffer cache hit ratio" 
| json "log" as _rawlog nodrop
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as oracle_log_message
| parse field=oracle_log_message " queryoutput=*" as jsonOUT 
| json field=jsonout "Cache Hit Ratio", "MONITOR_TYPE" as cachehitratio, monitorType
| where monitorType="buffer cache hit ratio"
| timeslice by 5m 
| max(cachehitratio) as %"CacheHitRatio" by _timeslice

db.cluster.name={{db.cluster.name}} deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} sumo.datasource=oracle "tablespace status"  | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as oracle_log_message
| parse field=oracle_log_message " queryoutput=*" as jsonOUT 
| json field=jsonOUT "Tablespace Name", "USED_SPACE", "MONITOR_TYPE","TOTAL_SPACE","FREE_SPACE" as tablespace_name, usedSpace, monitorType, totalSpace, freeSpace
| where monitorType="tablespace status"
| (usedSpace/totalSpace*100) as Percent_Tablespace_Utilization
| timeslice 5m
| max(Percent_Tablespace_Utilization) as Percent_Tablespace_Utilization by tablespace_name, _timeslice
| sort by Percent_Tablespace_Utilization desc 
| transpose row _timeslice column tablespace_name

db.cluster.name={{db.cluster.name}} deployment.environment={{deployment.environment}} sumo.datasource=oracle "session waits" | json "log" as _rawlog nodrop 
| if (isEmpty(_rawlog), _raw, _rawlog) as oracle_log_message
| parse field=oracle_log_message " queryoutput=*" as jsonOUT 
| json field=jsonOUT "MONITOR_TYPE","SECONDS_IN_WAIT","USERNAME","STATE","EVENT" as monitorType, secondsinwait, username, state, event
| where monitorType="session waits"
| count as eventCount by event 
| top 10 event by eventCount, event asc

panels.text:
####The Sumo app for Oracle uses a Python script to query database tables to collect Oracle server performance metrics.
####The script connects the database using a database user account, runs a set of example SQL queries, and prints the query results in JSON format to the console.
